pipelines.name: open_account_data_collection
pipelines.description: Daily (T-1) pipeline collecting the open_saving_logs file (log of open digital-savings-account activity, used to support marketing) from FTP. Validates checksum, stores a raw copy in the HDFS raw zone, copies it to the HDFS cleansed zone, stages it in the HDFS gold_safe zone, then loads it into Hive (prod_safe_mymo.open_saving_logs).
